en: Colored postcard-style panoramic view of a small spa town surrounded by forests and fields. The foreground shows tree-lined streets and villas along a lake with boats and a small pavilion on the shore. Behind the lake rise densely packed houses and larger hotel-like buildings, and a prominent church with a tall spire stands on a slight hill. In the far background are open fields and wooded hills. The caption "Bad Elster" appears in the top-right corner in red script.
